task: Core #1186 F6-U03l: pin 78-source ordered release candidate manifest and prove legacy inbound v2/v3 final PostgreSQL17 EXECUTE privileges

assuranceCeiling.rationale: Critical read-only source-only review candidate and Docker PG17 final ACL proof. No production migration, provider integration, hosted replay or tenant approval. Source hashes and real runtime grants are independent authorities.

acceptanceCriteria: Canonical reviewed baseline verifies exact 59 Git blobs and companion source SQL; 19 Office main SQL blob IDs come from existing source identity guard, including unique v2 precursor; no tampering.

Emit one versioned review-candidate manifest with unique 78 ordinal source items, ordered preflight/59+19 original SQL/postflight and cryptographic digest of each original source and overall bundle, and releaseAuthorized=false.
Original customer-baseline 0055 must follow 18 prior Office source creators; Office FK follow-up must follow 0057 and precede 0058; no old file bodies changed.

Dedicated true Docker PostgreSQL17 checks real peer/container identity, fixed local db and roles before any SQL, then real source-original COMMIT + postflight. New final v2/v3 ACL query is run after COMMIT.

Runtime v2 EXECUTE denied to anon/authenticated/service_role (including any default PUBLIC grant); runtime v3 EXECUTE denied to anon/authenticated but granted to service_role. A v2 owner/superuser bypass does not count.
Unit negative tests simulate ACL contradictions, function absence, wrong file order/source drift and attempted production authorization; fail-closed throughout.
Original F6-U03b abort-before-DROP and F6-U03f strict guard remain unmodified; normal exact-head CI and Truth/Lifecycle verify only this candidate manifest/privilege diagnostic.
invariants: All 78 original SQL source files are unchanged and pinned to their source Git blob authority, 59 customer-baseline and 19 historical main.
The candidate manifest must never be interpreted as production deployable. `releaseAuthorized` and `hostedTouched` always false.
Every SQL execution endpoint is an isolated, exact-identity checked Docker PG17 ephemeral database; no hosted PG selectors inherited.
Final read-only ACL statement checks exact v2/v3 function names, arg signatures and explicit PostgreSQL roles with effective grants; no SQL mutation after positive COMMIT.
Owner/superuser EXECUTE is not equivalent to safe service_role endpoint grants; deny browser and service_role on v2.
Successful offline candidate compile or source test alone cannot be called provider or tenant RLS completion.
forbiddenStates: An approved hosted release package or reset is inferred from passing local v2/v3 role grants.
Legacy sender-thread-only security-definer v2 function is executable by anon, authenticated, service_role or PUBLIC at end of migration.
Production v3 inbound entrypoint is callable by anon/authenticated or unavailable to service_role due to accidental privilege drift.
Any synthetic Office table or function is introduced into local fixture rather than original source SQL.
Source-only candidate manifest includes different number/order/bytes while still reporting source-verified.
Actual Supabase schema or staging/platform/Fresh Install project is modified.

failureModes: Legacy v2 function's service_role grant is not actually removed because future SQL restores it or mismatches the overloaded signature.
PUBLIC gets implicit EXECUTE on a newly defined function and one of the `REVOKE ALL` steps is missing; per-role checks might conceal PUBLIC entry if not checked.
Unpinned SQL creator bytes from main drift; new 78-source manifest incorrectly trusts filenames instead of Git blobs.
An old provider role's permission is inherited by authenticated even when direct grantee ACL is absent.
SQL fails but CI incorrectly runs ACL against an earlier schema or an empty provider fixture.
SQL source order places 20260910070300 FK follow-up before original 0055 and reports an unrelated missing-column failure.
edgeCases: Source SQL contains PostgreSQL dollar-quoted bodies with `$'` and `$$`; candidate compiler must use callback-safe literal concatenation and Git blobs.
Real function signature v3 is eleven arguments and text array/integer; exact oid equality required.
Membership/inherited role privileges may make has_function_privilege true despite direct ACL grantee checks being absent.
Postflight marker appears in a comment or earlier log even though COMMIT did not happen; require process exit zero and final COMMIT plus catalog.
Role `PUBLIC` has pseudograntee OID zero; avoid treating `public` schema/real role as equivalent.
Branch is stacked on draft #1355; no parallel changes or merging parent while evidence is gathered.

alternatives.summary: Versioned immutable source review-candidate plus real Docker PG17 effective ACL query and negative tests.
alternatives.reason: Limits risk, validates real final permissions and makes next source-authorized release stage auditable.

alternatives.summary: Immediately migrate the 78 original historical SQL sources to hosted Fresh Install or promote draft package to release.
alternatives.reason: Would bypass managed provider/TLS/signed-in RLS, supersession reviews and explicit hosted abort-before-DROP.

alternatives.summary: Check that text contains REVOKE but skip actual pg_proc and has_function_privilege runtime test.
alternatives.reason: Cannot detect inherited privileges, default PUBLIC grants or overloaded signature mistakes.

specialistReviews.finding: Checking only text REVOKE is inadequate and a successful local ACL probe may be mistaken for provider-level authorization.
specialistReviews.resolution: Require post-commit real has_function_privilege and PUBLIC grantee checks for exact v2/v3 signatures, then explicitly keep signed-in tenant/managed provider blocked.

specialistReviews.finding: A manifest naming 78 files without cryptographic identities/order could silently permit modified SQL.
specialistReviews.resolution: Use canonical existing reviewed SHA authority for 59 and original main Git identities for 19; duplicate and sequence negative tests.

specialistReviews.finding: Existing historical source compiler had JS `$` replacement issues; new copy-paste would create parallel authority and drift.
specialistReviews.resolution: Reuse exact F6-U03k composer and source hash verification, not a duplicate migration compiler; derive ordered manifest from its verified output.

specialistReviews.finding: Real Docker roles and functions do not demonstrate authenticated Supabase JWT authorization or provider-managed infrastructure.
specialistReviews.resolution: Persist releaseAuthorized=false and providerAuthProven=false; new release package still demands human source supersession approval and independent tenant JWT tests.

challenge.scenario: One 59 reviewed customer-baseline source or 19 historical Office source is changed without changing filename, and the proposed candidate still counts 78 files.
challenge.finding: A versioned manifest could legitimize unreviewed SQL, break exact-head source authority and silently weaken a function's privileges.
challenge.resolution: Invoke original 59 Git-blob source reviewer and canonical main 19 Git-blob verifier, include exact source sha per ordinal manifest item and fail before generating candidate if any bytes differ.

challenge.scenario: All 78 SQL files execute but record_inbound_office_email_v2(text,text,text,text,text) retains effective EXECUTE for service_role due to a later GRANT or default PUBLIC grant.
challenge.finding: The legacy sender-only security-definer email API could be called despite v3 intended replacement; contains a cross-topic/thread risk.
challenge.resolution: After real COMMIT, use role-based has_function_privilege for anon, authenticated and service_role plus pg_proc PUBLIC acl item, fail closed on any true result for exact v2 signature.

challenge.scenario: v3 record_inbound_office_email_v3 has multiple overloads and test checks the wrong function or its synthetic wrapper.
challenge.finding: A misleading green SQL test misses the current security-definer API's correct 11-argument signature and browser role exposure.
challenge.resolution: Lookup pg_proc by to_regprocedure with full signature, assert exact OID, run effective privileges separately for each role and assert v3 service_role true/anon/authenticated false.

challenge.scenario: A CI libpq selector redirects psql to hosted Fresh Install or platform during historical SQL replay.
challenge.finding: Even unchanged source SQL can overwrite production objects or violate explicit hosted authority.
challenge.resolution: Verify real Docker peer IP, fixed local DB/role/PG17, reject PGHOST/PGHOSTADDR/PGOPTIONS/DATABASE_URL/SUPABASE_DB_URL and never accept hosted execution mode.

challenge.scenario: The candidate manifest inserts original Communication Hub FK index SQL before source 0055 and original Office grants fail due to missing target columns.
challenge.finding: Incorrect order gives a fabricated SQL dependency error while an invalid package is marked versioned and reviewable.
challenge.resolution: Build ordinals directly from existing proven F6-U03k diagnostic source markers and assert FK source after 0057 before 0058, 18 predecessors before 0055 and no duplicates.

challenge.scenario: An old Office function's public EXECUTE implicit default survives but direct privilege rows show no anon/authenticated grant.
challenge.finding: Direct pg_proc proacl inspection alone can fail to detect inherited privileges; browser roles may effectively execute dangerous functions.
challenge.resolution: Assert no effective EXECUTE via has_function_privilege for every role and a distinct PUBLIC pseudo-grantee acl item check; include negative unit tests for contradictions.

challenge.scenario: Original SQL transaction fails or postflight does not run, but CI continues to ACL verification against provider bootstrap and calls it PASS.
challenge.finding: Release manifest would be backed by a nonexistent installed schema and function privileges could be read from an incomplete database.
challenge.resolution: Use psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 and exit, original postflight marker, final COMMIT and post-commit check for both exact function OIDs and baseline schema objects; no swallow failure.

challenge.scenario: The critical source candidate and native role ACL prove GREEN on Docker fixture, and output is mislabeled production release approved or signed-in Alap/Pro JWT tested.
challenge.finding: Provider-managed Auth/Storage, HTTPS/TLS endpoint identity, signed-in tenant RLS, supersession and customer journey acceptance remain untested.
challenge.resolution: Force manifest.releaseAuthorized=false, hostedTouched=false, providerManaged=false and tenantJwtRlsProven=false; require separately reviewed authority and real provider proof for any promotion.

proofPlan: Run exact branch Development Guard, read applicable 31 Known Failures and critical Plan Before Code with resolved specialist/negative challenges before implementation.
Build source-only versioned release-candidate manifest from existing F6-U03k canonical 78-source compiler with source-order markers and Git provenance.
Adversarial unit tests on absent/duplicated/reordered source, unauthorized release flag, v2/v3 ACL contradictions, wrong function/role and postflight missing.
Use real independently identity-checked Docker PG17 with original existing bootstrap and exact canonical 78 SQL COMMIT plus source postflight; post-COMMIT SQL ACL probes on real roles.
Verify normal exact-head Shoperation CI Quality, TypeScript, production build, Security Audit, Completion Truth, Lifecycle and dedicated ACL proof, then close scoped unit only.
operationalIntelligence.problemStatement: Genuine local Docker PG17 proof #38808912158 established 59 reviewed customer baseline SQL + 19 authentic original Office SQL in one transaction with original postflight, and atomic rollback. The sole successful concatenation is a diagnostic, not yet a source-authorized versioned release manifest. Historical security-definer inbound v2 temporarily receives EXECUTE service_role until later inbound v3 source explicitly REVOKEs it. Must certify final PostgreSQL17 role privileges and pin a versioned ordered 78-source candidate without copying/altering original SQL or promoting a local replay as an approved release.
observableOutcomes: Emit deterministic, versioned machine-readable review-candidate manifest for all 78 original ordered sources with 59 unchanged Git-reviewed customer-baseline files and 19 Git-blob-pinned original Office source files; preserve exactly 18 pre-0055 and one post-0057 placement.
Expose immutable source path, SHA identity, ordinal and source-authority references per entry; refuse missing/duplicated/reordered original inputs and any attempted releaseApproved=true.

Run true Docker PostgreSQL17 original 78-file migration transaction, source target-preflight/postflight and one COMMIT, followed by read-only pg_proc ACL privileges for exact v2/v3 signature and real PostgreSQL roles anon/authenticated/service_role.
Ensure has_function_privilege for all 3 roles returns FALSE for legacy v2, and only service_role returns TRUE for v3, with no PUBLIC pseudo-role EXECUTE grant or elevated security-definer exposure.
Negative checks fail CI on any mistaken grant, missing function, changed source, wrong identity or query ambiguity; Docker truth is NOT an authenticated Alap/Pro tenant session proof.
All exact-head canonical Development Guard, Plan Before Code, dedicated runtime ACL tests, Quality/TS/Build/Security, Completion Truth/Lifecycle pass scoped diagnostic only.
unresolvedRisks: A final PostgreSQL ACL probe cannot establish correct end-to-end JWT/RLS or provider-managed Auth/Storage semantics; actual signed-in Alap/Pro isolation remains blocked.
Old timestamped Office source may contain other stale policy grants or RPCs beyond v2; full privilege/supersession audit remains required for approval.
Existing frozen 59 source reviewer is immutable. This unit produces a non-executable release CANDIDATE only, not a new approved 78-file production migration package.
Historical Docker provider shell includes synthetic Auth role contracts that differ from real hosted Supabase; hosted TLS/target-postflight proof remains unauthorized.

in: Pure deterministic F6-U03l versioned 78-source review-candidate manifest derived from existing canonical F6-U03k original SQL and F6-U03j source Git authorities.
Real isolated Docker PostgreSQL17 runtime ACL proof after genuine source 78-file COMMIT: v2 denied anon/authenticated/service_role and v3 service_role only.
Positive and adversarial no-grant, public-grant, query failure and unauthorized scope test cases, artifacts, project governance.
out: No new release SQL, no edits in supabase/customer-baseline or supabase/migrations, no changes to approved source hashes.
No hosted Supabase operations, new projects, project unpause, schema reset, credentials, signed-in customer sessions or permission to merge.
No claim that v2/v3 privilege probes close all Office RPCs, all tenant RLS or full managed provider release readiness.
